name: Reincarnated as a Sword
description: Reincarnated as a sentient weapon with memories of his past life, but not his name, a magical sword saves a young beastgirl from a life of slavery. Fran, the cat-eared girl, becomes his wielder, and wants only to grow stronger, while the sword wants to know why he is here. Together, the strange duo's journey has only just begun!

videos.title: Catgirl Meets Sword
videos.overview: A sentient sword. A powerless girl. The adventure of a lifetime begins when Fran, an enslaved cat-girl, stumbles upon a living blade in her darkest hour.

videos.title: The Hellish Trial at the Adventurer's Guild
videos.overview: To become a full-fledged adventurer, Fran must pass an intimidating test. But even if she passes, will other adventurers give a lowly cat-girl a chance to fit in?

videos.title: The Grizzled Old Blacksmith
videos.overview: New gear, fancy digs, yummy food — Fran is in heaven. The only thing that could make this better is a fun guild mission! But dangers lurk in the shadows, waiting to strike…

videos.title: The Terrifying Goblin Stampede
videos.overview: Growth and responsibility go hand in hand. After her recent exploits, Fran is offered an unusual job that will her test all her hard-won new abilities.

videos.title: The Feeble First Dungeon
videos.overview: Propelled by promises of curry, Fran rushes in with Teacher at her side… but their target, the Dungeon Master, does not wait for them alone.

videos.title: The Greater Demon Cheated
videos.overview: Fran and Teacher face off against their toughest adversary yet, but it’s not just their lives on the line. The fate of everyone in Alessa rests on their shoulders.

videos.title: The Horrible Lieutenant of the Knights Brigade
videos.overview: Monsters aren’t the only adversaries waiting to challenge Fran, but defeating slimy nobles at their own game will take a specialized approach — and a certain new skill.

videos.title: The Villainous Blue Cat
videos.overview: Which foe presents the tougher challenge: the mortal enemy of the Black Cats, or the fear of what that enemy represents? Fran will overcome them all in her quest for justice.

videos.title: The Monstrous Rank A Adventurer
videos.overview: Fran sets out with a party to tackle the Spider's Nest, but one party member isn't convinced she deserves her rank. A friendly duel will set the record straight.

videos.title: The Totally Unfair Spider Traps
videos.overview: The party ventures into the Spider’s Web dungeon… But are they the hunters or the prey?

videos.title: The Wolf Summoned Hither
videos.overview: When Fran and Teacher are separated, Teacher is faced with a decision that could destroy him — but desperate times call for desperate measures.

videos.title: An Excited Fran Sets Off
videos.overview: It’s a race against time as Fran and Teacher rush to the aid of the adventuring party. In the aftermath, Amanda reflects on an unexpected connection she has to Fran.
